policy_semantics: NON_COMPLIANT means one or more required PPE classes were not detected for at least one detected person. It does not prove physical absence.
notes: PPE-v2m runtime configuration (operator decision 2026-10-13). Same compliance policy, thresholds and association as PPE-v1; only the detector (YOLOv8m at 1024 px) differs. The detector was chosen after a post-hoc locked-test evaluation, so its locked-test figures are optimistic until confirmed on a fresh held-out set. PPE-v1 (ppe_config.json) stays frozen and selectable with DCG_PPE_DETECTOR=v1.
